title.rendered: Board of Directors Meeting/Work Session – Rescheduled to January 20, 2021

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Work Session and Regular Meeting on Wednesday, January 20, 2021 (rescheduled from previous January 13 date). To access a livestream video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

  • 5:30pm – Executive Session (Non-Public Meeting)
  • 6:00pm – Work Session (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)
  • 7:00pm – Regular Meeting (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)

The agenda for this meeting can be viewed here.

To submit public comment, please use form found here. Public comment will be read during the meeting by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes per comment (as per time limit indicated on meeting agenda). Please note that this is a new form than the one used if you submitted public comment for the January 6 meeting; each meeting has a unique form, and the previous meeting’s form no longer accepts comment submissions.
